name: Visual Semiconductor Inc.
old_description: From phones and tablets to laptops and televisions, consumers are always looking for improvements that make their user experiences more impactful. VSI intends to develop and implement new solutions that offer enhanced viewing and user engagement through glasses-free and other advanced technologies.
about:
Visual Semiconductor Inc. is based in Bensalem, Pennsylvania. The company has been operating since at least 2022, as indicated by its copyright notice, and focuses on developing glasses-free 3D display technology under the GF3D™ brand.

The company designs application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) to power its proprietary 3D chips, coordinating with foundries such as TSMC for fabrication. It also collaborates with top panel manufacturers to integrate emerging display technologies including miniLED, microLED, and Dynamic AMOLED. Its development efforts target consumer devices such as phones, tablets, laptops, and televisions, as well as large-format screens for live events, advertising, and cinema. The company has demonstrated a 65-inch 8K GF3D™ prototype and offers private demos.

Visual Semiconductor serves the consumer electronics, television, and large-venue display markets, along with emerging sectors such as the metaverse, virtual reality, augmented reality, and holographic displays. Its customers include device makers, panel manufacturers, and strategic partners seeking immersive viewing solutions.

The company differentiates itself through its glasses-free 3D approach that eliminates the need for glasses, goggles, or eye-tracking, and through its proprietary ASIC architecture designed for high-volume, low-cost production with enhanced IP security. Access to next-generation panel technologies via its industry relationships is also cited as a competitive advantage.
